absent: Numeric values of per type initial inode numbers and initial tree identifiers and the last initial identifier threshold.
Implementations of shared internal helpers for namespace setup and teardown and active count management and raw tree insertion and removal and RCU adjoin.
Layout of proc operations and contents of initial namespace instances and per type tree roots.
Live nvmem provider behaviour when enabled, including success paths for registration and cell creation and layout probing plus locking and error handling.
Objagg aggregation semantics, object identity and comparison, root and delta lifetime, and synchronisation.
Objpool pool creation and destruction, slot sizing, growth, release callback contract, and header reference counting.
Concrete meaning of each unwind hint type and consumption of discard section records by tooling.
Full locking and RCU protocol around namespace trees beyond the shown helpers.

findings.text: The ns_common header keeps a passive lifetime count isolated for cache behaviour plus a numeric type tag and an inode number and a stashed dentry pointer and a proc operations pointer together with embedded tree state and an RCU callback node. The raw passive count must not be used directly.

The to_ns_common selector yields the address of the embedded ns_common header from any namespace carrier and preserves constness. It supports cgroup plus IPC plus mount plus network plus PID plus time plus user plus UTS carriers.

Initial values are chosen by the static carrier type. Separate selectors provide the initial inode number and the initial instance address and the initial tree identifier and the proc operations table. Several operations entries depend on build configuration and become null when that namespace kind is disabled.

The FOR_EACH_NS_TYPE enumeration pairs each namespace kind with its clone flag, covering cgroup and IPC and mount and network and PID and time and user and UTS in one shared list reused by aggregate and per type mappings.
The CLONE_NS_ALL aggregate equals the bitwise OR of every clone flag from the shared enumeration starting from zero. It denotes the full set of namespace creation flags.
The ns_common_type mapping reports the clone flag matching the static carrier type by reusing the shared eight pair enumeration.
The ns_tree_root combines a balanced tree root with a list head, while ns_tree_node combines a balanced tree node with a list entry. Together they support lookup by identifier plus list traversal.
The ns_tree state holds a numeric identifier and an active count plus a unified node and a per type node and an owner node together with an owner root for children it owns.

The is_ns_init_inum check recognises initial inode numbers by membership in the reserved initial interval, while is_ns_init_id recognises initial identifiers by comparison against the last initial identifier. Both warn when the examined value is zero.

The NS_COMMON_INIT static description fills type and identifier and inode number and operations from the per type selectors and clears stashed and sets passive and active counts to one and initialises the unified plus per type plus owner list entries and the owned list head as empty.

The ns_common_init family forwards a typed carrier to shared internal setup after deriving its header and type and operations, selecting the initial inode number only for the initial instance and otherwise using zero or a caller value. The ns_common_free helper forwards a typed carrier to shared release.

Namespace lifetime uses passive references plus an active liveness count. Initial instances remain pinned at one for both and never release. Other instances allow conditional acquisition only while passive count is nonzero and release on the last passive drop when no active users remain, with a combined drop and lock variant and an acquire unless inactive check that fails when active count is zero.

The ns_ref and ns_ref_active wrappers accept typed carriers and tolerate null with neutral results. They expose reading plus increment plus conditional get plus put plus locked put for passive counts and reading plus get plus put for active counts.

Reference paths warn when an initial instance shows counts different from one and when release or failed acquisition observes unexpected active users. Such warnings indicate use after deactivation or broken accounting.
The VFS_WARN_ON_ONCE helper has two build dependent forms. One issues a once only runtime warning for its condition and the other only checks the condition at build time with no runtime effect.

The ns_get_path_helper_t callback resolves a shared header from opaque data for path operations. Current instance selectors return the caller current carrier for each kind using task proxy state for most kinds with dedicated accessors for PID and user kinds, and current_in_namespace tests equality against a given instance.

The to_ns_tree selector yields the global per type tree for any carrier across all eight kinds. The ns_tree_gen_id helper derives the shared header and requests the initial identifier only for the initial instance, otherwise requesting automatic allocation.

Tree membership generates an identifier then links into the selected tree, with a raw link variant that skips generation. Removal unlinks from the same tree and an RCU adjoin helper records predecessor linkage, while ns_tree_active reports attached state by testing whether the per type node remains empty.
The __ns_tree_add entry generates an identifier for a supplied header and tree before performing the raw insertion step.
The nvmem_type kind unknown is zero followed by EEPROM and OTP and battery backed and FRAM kinds. The NVMEM_DEVID_NONE sentinel is minus one and the NVMEM_DEVID_AUTO sentinel is minus two.

A nvmem_keepout entry records start and end offsets plus a fill value. A nvmem_cell_info entry records name and offset and raw length and byte width and bit offset and bit width plus a device tree node and an optional read post processing callback with private data.
Provider register callbacks abstract reads and writes by private context and offset, while cell post processing abstracts per cell fixup by private context and cell identity and index.

The nvmem_config structure binds device and name and identifier and owner plus a cell array and count and a legacy fixed cells flag and an optional fixup hook plus a keepout array and count plus type and read only and root only and ignore write protection flags plus layout and device tree node plus register callbacks plus size and word size and stride geometry plus private context plus legacy compat device fields.
A nvmem_layout embeds a device and a back pointer to its device plus an add cells operation. A nvmem_layout_driver embeds a device driver plus probe and remove operations for layout instances.
Layout driver registration binds a driver to its register helper with the current module owner, and module boilerplate pairs register with unregister for a given driver instance.

When provider support is unavailable the visible nvmem entry points report operation not supported for registration and single cell addition and layout registration and device tree cell creation, while device managed registration forwards to plain registration and unregister and layout unregister do nothing and container lookup returns null.

The objagg_ops table carries object size plus a delta compatibility check and delta creation and destruction plus root creation and destruction. Accounting uses per object user counts including delta users plus an info entry pairing counters with its object and a root flag plus a variable length summary with root and entry counts.
The OBJAGG_OBJ_ROOT_ID_INVALID sentinel equals the maximum unsigned value. The objagg optimisation selector offers only OBJAGG_OPT_ALGO_SIMPLE_GREEDY.

An objpool_slot holds head and tail and publish positions plus a mask over a flexible entry array in packed layout. An objpool_head records object size and object totals and possible CPU count and capacity and allocation flags and reference count and option flags plus the per CPU slot table and a release callback with context. Companion callback types initialise single objects and finalise a pool.
The OBJPOOL_NR_OBJECT_MAX limit is one shifted left by twenty four and the OBJPOOL_OBJECT_SIZE_MAX limit is one shifted left by sixteen.

Slot state separates reservation from visibility. Consumers validate that the publish sequence trails head within capacity then load an entry before advancing head with release atomic update, retrying on contention or skewed snapshots. Producers reserve a tail position with acquire atomic update then store the object before publishing with release ordering.

The objpool_pop operation scans per CPU slots starting at the current processor and wrapping over all possible processors until success, while objpool_push inserts only into the current processor slot. Both disable local interrupts around slot access to prevent migration and interruption.

Pool paths serialise by disabling and restoring local interrupts around slot updates and rely on atomic positions without sleeping. Namespace final drop can atomically acquire a caller supplied spinlock. The shared header carries an RCU node for deferred freeing after a grace period.
The unwind_hint record holds an instruction address and a stack offset and a stack register selector and a type tag and a signal flag in compact integer fields.

Unwind hint types run zero through seven for undefined and end of stack and call and full registers and partial registers and function and save and restore. The corresponding macros are UNWIND_HINT_TYPE_UNDEFINED and UNWIND_HINT_TYPE_END_OF_STACK and UNWIND_HINT_TYPE_CALL and UNWIND_HINT_TYPE_REGS and UNWIND_HINT_TYPE_REGS_PARTIAL and UNWIND_HINT_TYPE_FUNC and UNWIND_HINT_TYPE_SAVE and UNWIND_HINT_TYPE_RESTORE.

Annotation helpers emit tool metadata into discard sections. UNWIND_HINT records stack register and offset and type and signal at the current address, STACK_FRAME_NON_STANDARD marks a function via a dedicated section pointer with a frame pointer variant that may expand to nothing, ASM_REACHABLE records reachability of the current address, and VALIDATE_UNRET_BEGIN aliases the underlying unreturn begin marker.

Insertion warns when reserved tail runs beyond observed head by more than total capacity. Retrieval must reload head when publish and head views disagree because the two positions update independently, and ordering requires entry load before head advance plus entry store before publish to avoid leaking empty slots.
Several headers provide once only inclusion guards that define a unique macro on first inclusion to prevent repeated processing.
